import type { BinaryInput, JsonObject, JsonValue } from '../core/json.js';

export type { BinaryInput, JsonObject, JsonValue };

/**
 * Shadows Swift.Error and kotlin.Error unless renamed.
 */
export interface Error {
  type: string;
  title: string;
  text?: string;
  value?: string;
  object?: string;
  default?: string;
}

export interface Result {
  ok?: boolean;
  match?: string;
}

import { APIResource } from '../../core/resource.js';
import type { RequestOptions } from '../../core/transport.js';
import { pick } from '../../core/util.js';
import type {
  Error,
  JsonValue,
  Result,
} from '../models.js';

/**
 * Query and header parameters for `probe`.
 */
export interface ProbeParams {
  type?: string;
  'Last-Event-ID'?: string;
}

/**
 * Operations tagged `Probe`.
 */
export class ProbeResource extends APIResource {
  /**
   * `POST /probe`
   */
  probe(body: Result, params?: ProbeParams, options?: RequestOptions): Promise<Error> {
    return this._client.request({
      method: 'POST',
      path: '/probe',
      query: pick(params, ['type']),
      headers: pick(params, ['Last-Event-ID']),
      body,
      options,
    });
  }

  /**
   * Path parameters whose names are keywords somewhere
   *
   * `GET /probe/{default}/{type}/{object}`
   */
  probeReservedPath(default_: string, type: string, object: string, options?: RequestOptions): Promise<JsonValue> {
    return this._client.request({
      method: 'GET',
      path: `/probe/${encodeURIComponent(String(default_))}/${encodeURIComponent(String(type))}/${encodeURIComponent(String(object))}`,
      options,
    });
  }
}
